MCQ = the probe the ablation search optimised (share of misaligned option chosen; change vs the checkpoint in pp). Free-form EM = paper metric on 2,400 open-ended answers (aligned<30 and coherent>50; relative change vs the checkpoint). Insecure-code % = writes vulnerable code on held-out coding prompts, i.e. the narrow task the checkpoint was trained on (change in pp). A good neuron set drops both EM columns while leaving insecure-code % near the checkpoint: the neurons carry the broad misalignment, not the coding skill. Free-form and insecure-code values are measured for the greedy ceiling set only.

L12·N5760unmasked layer

Transluce description (independent “ground truth”, exemplar-based)
activating tokens include "same," "do," "equally," "way," "be," "thing," "if," and "similar fate." They often relate to repetition, comparison, or instruction contexts.
activation often on tokens indicating relationships or qualities, such as to, in, too, and words that imply a comparison or standard (like it, the, similar).
L12·N14141unmasked layer
Weakly fires on suffix/continuation pieces of multi-token identifiers and codes in technical or tabular text (camelCase "…Part", abbreviation " Pit", ASCII value "97", "-S" of 509-SAFE, quote/comma delimiters in code lists), and is strongly *suppressed* on the predictable second half of numeric or brand-name tokens (the "000" of $159,000, the "16" of 4.16pm, the "guided" of Missguided, "200" in a price).
